deviation.what: no re-aim setting met re-find errors <= 1% on Tier 1 dev; C4 frozen in re-plan-only mode
deviation.prereg_gap: the preregistration did not say what to do when no setting meets the cap

tuned_on: full dev (variants 0-1); C4/C2 on Tier 1 dev
rule: C4: s/step at p=0.05 with re-find errors <= 1% of re-aims; C2 and question thresholds at <= 2% FA

C5.what: no escalation setting met re-find errors <= 1% on Tier 1 dev (150-pair subset); not frozen; lowest-error setting kept as exploratory C5r

C6.what: no escalation setting met re-find errors <= 1% on Tier 1 dev (150-pair subset); not frozen; lowest-error setting kept as exploratory C6r
